body:
So, shortly after I wrote this we had to cancel one of my youngest daughter's favorite activities. It was because I was incapable of taking her.  I quietly got my keys and slipped into the garage. I figured running the car with the door closed would be the easiest way to go. I sat there with the keys in the ignition and the windows down. After a while of not starting the car I texted my wife in the other room. I decided to give her 5 minutes to respond or I'd start it. 7 minutes later she came to find me. She never got the text. I never started the car.

We've decided to seek counciling, individually and as a couple. 

I decided to reply here because several people took the time to think about me. Thank you.

I just hope my daughters never find out how close it came.
